{{Quote|We need to protect the settlement, ''Rex''. Gather all the miners together&mdash;''and activate the deflector shield''!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]|<ref name="Keep the Faith!">{{TCWComicCite|6.2|Keep the Faith!}}</ref>}}
A '''mining settlement''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taronda]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was [[Battle of Taronda|attacked]] by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], who hoped to divert the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] attention from claiming Taronda's raw materials.
